rows.behavior: The skill .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md is named release, every -f KEY= it names is a release.yml input, its package values match that input's options, and every path it cites exists.
rows.fails_when: the name differs, an input or package is made up, or a cited path is missing

rows.behavior: The skill explains why release.yml and release-tag.yml both exist and that apm/apm.yml is kmctl's version source because users pin the APM package to the CLI tag.
.claude/rules/releases.md keeps the no --admin rule and every-release-has-notes, reworded for notes reviewed in the pull request, and names .claude/skills/release/.
rows.fails_when: a rule is missing, it still says to regenerate notes by hand after publishing as the only path, or it does not name the skill
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_rules.py tests/test_release_skill.py -k rule -q
